description: NCMT Existing Substations/Terminals/Power Stations (WP-049) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Power. The Existing Substations/Terminals/Power Stations and Annual Planning Report Information layer, indicating the majority of the point locations for facilities of the following types contained within the SWIS: Current Western Power Substation Current Non Western Power Substation Current Western Power Terminal/Power Station Current Non Western Power Terminal/Power Station This data is the same as, and supports ... Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Western Power. Its tags are NCMT, electric, infrastructure, network, power. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
